finding: Harness v0.1 artifact, not the baseline. (1) 102/178 steps were identical re-submitted patches after a failing verifier result — a harness gap (no post-failure nudge), fixed in v0.2. (2) The system-prompt example named a concrete region/class (producer/off_by_one); the recorded first-hypothesis distribution is transform 9 / producer 5 / consumer 1, so the model did NOT simply copy it, but a concrete example is a possible bias and v0.2 uses placeholders. (3) First hypothesis followed the symptom region in only 2/15 cases — the untrained model already searches upstream of the symptom; this is the prior the experience module must beat, and it argues for measuring hypothesis ORDER against the true bug region rather than herring-following alone.
